subtitle: The Tollhouse Chest

briefing.text: The chest is recovered. Bring Mira back to the crypt keep and a skeletal servant to the adjacent muster. The Circle is trying to cut off the patrol.
Recover the estate’s toll chest from the occupied yard, then bring Mira and a skeletal servant back to the crypt muster. The Circle holds the trees on both sides of the road.

intro.text: The toll chest is still in that yard. Take it. I will not ask our master for another coin while Vael sits on his road.
The offer stands: stop digging grave-soil beside our trees, and turn back.
My master refused you. I have come for his property, not your terms. Bring the chest back to the crypt, with enough servants left to carry it.
Then the boundary will close behind you. Our guardian is already at the stone.

victory.text: A guardian on the boundary stone, roots across the road, and more spears answering from the grove. That is how Vael holds this ground.
We have the coin. Next time we split his stone and find a way around those trees.

debrief: The chest pays for another levy. Mira has seen how the boundary stone feeds the road thorns; the estate can now strike at the mechanism rather than fight along the road again.
